# EduAnant

> EduAnant is an offline-ready school management system (school ERP) built for
> Indian schools by Snapx Technologies LLP, Patna, Bihar. It installs on a
> school's own PC or server and runs over the school's local Wi-Fi, so the fee
> counter, attendance register and office keep working when the broadband line
> is down.

## Facts (Release 1.4.0, September 2026)

- **16 fully wired modules**, all included with every school — no tier to upgrade to.
- **100+ production screens** across the admin console and both portals.
- **2 self-service portals** (Teacher, and Student/Parent) plus an admin console
  and a native Android app.
- **96 granular permission keys** across 22 permission groups, assignable per user.
- **Runs offline on the school intranet.** No internet dependency, no monthly cloud bill.
- **Interface in English and Hindi**, switchable in one click.
- **Supports CBSE, ICSE and State Board** schools on an April–March session.
- **Pricing:** ₹20 per student per month billed annually (₹25 billed monthly),
  with a ₹36,000 annual minimum covering up to 150 students. Setup, data
  migration from Excel, staff training and the Android app are included.

## In production

S.D.V. Public School, Patna, Bihar (CBSE affiliated, three campuses,
https://sdv-edu.in) has run EduAnant since April 2026 — over 1,300 active
students and more than 100 school staff, through full admission, fee and
examination cycles.

## The 16 modules

Registrations & Admissions; Fee Management; Student Attendance; Human Resources
& Staff Attendance; Examination & Results; Library Management; Reception Counter;
Transport Management; Academics & Calendar; Communication & Notifications;
Classroom & Teaching; Reports & Analytics; Portals & Mobile App; Security &
Access Control; Backup & Restore; System Configuration & Updates.

## Who it is for

School directors and founders choosing a system; principals and administrators
running daily operations; accountants and fee clerks at the counter; front-desk
and reception staff; class teachers marking attendance and entering marks;
librarians, transport managers and HR staff; and parents and students using the
portal and Android app.

## Data ownership and security

The database is standard PostgreSQL on the school's own machine. Student data
never leaves the campus, is never shared with third parties, and can be exported
in full at any time. Every action is written to an immutable audit trail that not
even the school admin can edit. Aadhaar, PAN and bank numbers are encrypted at
rest and masked on screen.
